Name: Livi's Feminine Scarecrows
Author: livipup
Description:
Redesigns of the scarecrows to look like girls. The regular scarecrow is changed to a slightly redesigned version of the vanilla spring rarecrow. There are two options which can be configured in the file SMAPI generates. The new spring rarecrow's fairy wings can be set to "blue" or "yellow". Default is yellow. The deluxe scarecrow style can be set to "legs" or "dress". The dress is the default option.

If you have a mod (such a Starblue Valley) installed which overwrites craftables with seasonal variants you will need to edit the appropriate images in that mod's assets folder to remove all of the scarecrows. If you don't do this you will see both scarecrow designs.

This mod is not complete. A future update will contain the remaining three rarecrows which I have yet to change.
